name: Natsuiro Celebration
original_name: 夏色セレブレーション
source: You're a high school student enyoing summer with your best friend Kumiko. One day of August, she receives a call from her father, telling her to go home in 21 days. You then start enjoying those last days together...
translation: 你是一名高中生，正与挚友久美子享受夏日时光。8月的一天，她接到父亲电话，被告知21天后必须回家。于是，你们开始珍惜并享受最后的相处时光…
